improvements.rationale: A compelling meta description improves click-through rates from search results by clearly stating what Gideon offers and the free trial opportunity. Open Graph tags ensure professional previews when shared on LinkedIn, Twitter, and Facebook—critical for B2B audiences. Including the Claude branding adds credibility, while mentioning the free searches creates a low-friction entry point.

improvements.suggestion:
Hero Headline: "Meet Gideon — Your AI Trade & Business Assistant"

Subheading: "Get instant answers, voice chat, and professional support for your business operations. Try three free searches — no card required."
improvements.rationale: This headline immediately introduces the product name and its core function, building brand recognition. The subheading highlights three key value props (instant answers, voice chat, professional support) while clearly communicating the risk-free trial offer. 'No card required' removes friction and builds trust, encouraging visitors to engage before hitting the paywall.

improvements.suggestion:
Q: What happens after my three free searches?

A: Once you've used your three complimentary searches, you'll be invited to join as a member to continue accessing Gideon. Membership starts at just US$2 per day, billed monthly—or save 30% with an annual plan. As a member, you unlock unlimited access to Gideon's AI-powered trade and business support, voice chat, and your own dedicated workspace.
improvements.rationale: This FAQ directly addresses the most likely friction point for trial users approaching the paywall. It transparently explains the transition from free to paid, reinforces value (unlimited access, voice chat, workspace), and highlights the annual savings—reducing uncertainty and encouraging conversion.
